instruction: Complete the task in Blender through visible GUI interaction only. Launch Blender from `/opt/blender/blender`. Use the included reference image, `geometry_report.csv`, and `hole_table.csv` to rebuild the fixture plate. The result must be one closed mesh object named `Plate`, dimensioned 4.0 x 2.0 x 0.2 Blender units, with six distinct applied through-bores in the two-row pattern from the table. Add the centered rectangular top pocket shown in the reference image: 2.0 x 0.8 Blender units in plan, centered at X=0 and Y=0, cut 0.08 Blender units down from the top face. Save the native scene as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`.
